title: Changing of the editors and JPR's role as a journal for the plankton research community
content: I am writing as the new Editor-in-Chief (EiC) of the Journal of Plankton Research (JPR) as of 1 January 2025. In this role, I am very much looking forward to some new challenges—hopefully more overall positive than difficult ones. I started as an Associate Editor (AE) with the journal in 2010 during Roger Harris’ tenure and have learned much about the journal through him as well as our retiring EiC John Dolan.
